---
title: "Galaxy route"
---

Each practical of the course can be done in two ways: on your laptop (the local tutorials of this site) or on
[Galaxy](https://usegalaxy.eu), with tutorials of the [Galaxy Training Network](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/microbiome/) (GTN).

**The whole class follows the same route.** For each practical, the teacher says which route we use.
If we have to change route during a practical (for example because a server is slow), everybody changes together
and we start the other route from its beginning.

The Galaxy tutorials use **their own data**, not the data of the local tutorials, unless the table says "same data".
The methods are the same; the numbers are not.

## Before the first Galaxy practical

1. Create an account on [usegalaxy.eu](https://usegalaxy.eu) and confirm your e-mail address (see the [home page](index.qmd)).
2. Join the training group of the course with the link given on the [home page](index.qmd).
3. Follow the [short introduction to Galaxy](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/introduction/tutorials/galaxy-intro-short/tutorial.html).

On Day 3 we do either the metatranscriptomics tutorial or the Nanopore 16S tutorial (below). The other one is for self-study.

::: {.callout-warning title="Metatranscriptomics tutorial: two tool versions differ on usegalaxy.eu"}
When you run a GTN tutorial, Galaxy offers the tool versions that the tutorial was written with.
On 12 November 2026, two tools of the metatranscriptomics tutorial were not installed on usegalaxy.eu in that exact version:

| The tutorial asks for | Use instead on usegalaxy.eu |
|---|---|
| HUMAnN "Regroup" table tool, version 3.9 | the same tool, version 3.8 |
| "Combine MetaPhlAn2 and HUMAnN2 outputs", version 0.2.0 | "Combine MetaPhlAn and HUMAnN outputs", version 0.3.0 |

If Galaxy says that a tool or a version is missing, search the tool by its name in the tool panel and use the version that is installed. Write down the version you used.
:::

## What differs between the two routes

- **Databases.** A result depends on the reference database and on its version. The local Day 1 tutorial uses the
  Kraken 2 database Standard-8 of October 2026. The Galaxy tutorial uses a larger database (PlusPF), and the
  Standard-8 database on usegalaxy.eu dates from June 2022. Expect different numbers, and always write down the
  database and its version.
- **Tools.** The Galaxy binning tutorial uses several binners and refines their bins; the local tutorial uses one
  binner (MetaBAT 2). The local DADA2 tutorial uses SILVA 138.2; the Galaxy DADA2 tutorial uses the SILVA release installed on Galaxy (132), which still has the old names of the phyla (Firmicutes, Bacteroidetes).
- **Waiting time.** On Galaxy your jobs wait in a queue with the jobs of other users. Start the long jobs before a
  break.

The GTN tutorials are updated regularly. The links were checked on 12 November 2026.
